newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares soften, seen hemmed in.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares soften, seen hemmed in.

text.p: Austrian shares ended marginally lower on Monday after aimless trading with investors sidelined ahead of the FOMC meeting tomorrow and U.S. economic data.
The ATX index of 21 blue chips fell 3.52 points, or 0.34 percent, to 1,036.01 after earlier rising to 1,040.54 points. Of its constituents, nine gained while 12 fell.
"We've sunk back into the old 1,020 to 1,040-point trading range," lamented one trader, adding today's session was devoid of direction and incentives.
"There could be some movement in certain issues which are technically poised to overcome resistance," said another trader. OMV, which closed at 1,050.5, faces resistance at 1,060, he said.
"VA Stahl should overcome 360, while Flughafen has room up to 600/620."
The day's worst performer was Vienna airport operator Flughafen Wien, falling 3.05 percent to 572. Chip-maker AMS was the top gainer, adding on 2.03 percent to 755.
The broad-based Vienna bourse index shed 0.54 points, or 0.13 percent, to 404.16.
The October ATX future lost 5.5 points to close at 1,041.55 on turnover of 627 contracts. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 274
